name: Croatia
title: Holidays in Croatia
intro: Clear sea, old towns and waterfalls. Here's where to go on holiday in Croatia, how long to stay and the best time to visit.
seo_title: Where to go in Croatia: the best places for a holiday

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Croatia?
faqs.answer: June and September are best: warm sea without the peak summer crowds. Plitvice Lakes is also lovely in May and October.

faqs.question: Where in Croatia should we go?
faqs.answer: Dubrovnik for its old town, Istria for food and road trips, Zadar for beaches and islands, and Plitvice Lakes for waterfalls.

faqs.question: How long should a holiday in Croatia be?
faqs.answer: A week is enough for one part of the coast. Plitvice Lakes needs only two or three nights.
